parameters.content:
## 1. Plan the searches
Runs Monday 07:00 (Europe/Istanbul) or manually. Reads every existing lead (for duplicate checks and the next Lead ID), then builds one search brief per segment. Edit the briefs in "Build Search Plan" to steer discovery.

## 2. Find companies (Claude web search, one call per brief)
"Find Companies with Claude" is the Anthropic node (Claude Sonnet 4.6) with Claude's built-in web search on (max 10 searches per brief). For each brief it runs the suggested Turkish and English searches, opens the company sites, and answers with a JSON list of up to 8 Turkish manufacturers with website, source URL, EU export evidence and a confidence score. If the call fails (credits exhausted, rate limit, outage), the error output runs the same call on "... (account 2)" with the second Anthropic credential. "Parse Companies" turns either reply into one item per company.

## 3. Save as New leads
Drops companies without a source, below 60 confidence, or already in the sheet (by website domain or name). Assigns the next Lead ID and appends rows with Stage = New, so WF1 picks them up at 08:00. Each company is also appended to the Log tab (decision log).

The Leads tab needs three extra columns: Source URL, Source Date, Confidence. The sheet needs a Log tab: Timestamp | Workflow | Lead ID | Company | Step | Input | Output | Reason.

value.Reason: ={{ 'Confidence >= 60 and not already in sheet; added as Stage = New. Skipped this run: ' + $json.skipped_summary }}

options.system:
You find candidate companies for Texprove, a Digital Product Passport SaaS for textile and apparel exporters to the EU. Use web search (at most 10 searches) to find textile or apparel MANUFACTURERS or EXPORTERS based in Turkey (Türkiye) that sell to European buyers, in the given segment. Start with the suggested searches, then open the company's own website to confirm it is a Turkish manufacturer and to find its EU export evidence.

Exclude: brands and retailers (buyers), sourcing agents, directories and marketplaces (europages, kompass, alibaba, foursource, made-in-turkey), associations, fairs, news and magazine sites, job sites, LinkedIn pages, PDFs, and companies outside Turkey. Skip companies named in the skip list.

For each company give: company (official name), website (the company's own homepage as https://domain; skip the company if you cannot find its own site), source_url (the page where you saw the EU export evidence), eu_evidence (one sentence quoting or closely paraphrasing what the page says about exports to Europe, EU countries or European customers; never record order volumes, prices or buyer names), confidence (0 to 100: 90 or more when EU markets, EU countries or European brands are named as customers; 60 to 89 when it shows exporting in general without EU specifics; below 60 when the EU link is only implied), segment (one of Knitwear, Woven apparel, Denim, Home textile, Fabric mill, Yarn, Sportswear, Technical textile, Other).

Respond with ONLY a JSON object, no markdown fences, no commentary: {"companies": [ ... ]}. Return an empty array if nothing qualifies.
